{{Elections in Kansas}}
The '''2026 Kansas Insurance Commissioner election''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect the [[Kansas Insurance Commissioner]]. Primary elections was held on August 4. Incumbent commissioner [[Vicki Schmidt]] decided to retire to run for [[2026 Kansas gubernatorial election|governor]].

==Republican primary==
===Candidates===
====Nominee====
*[[Daniel Hawkins (politician)|Daniel Hawkins]], speaker of the [[Kansas House of Representatives]] (2023–present) from the 100th district (2013–present)<ref>{{cite web |title=Kansas House Speaker Dan Hawkins announces run for state insurance commissioner |url=https://www.kake.com/home/kansas-house-speaker-dan-hawkins-announces-run-for-state-insurance-commissioner/article_e896163f-7f9a-436e-a6ab-8c92f3316250.html |website=KAKE |access-date=May 13, 2025 |date=May 13, 2025}}</ref>

====Declined====
*[[Vicki Schmidt]], incumbent [[Kansas Insurance Commissioner|insurance commissioner]] ''(ran for [[2026 Kansas gubernatorial election|governor]])''<ref>{{cite news |last1=Brunner |first1=Melissa |title=Schmidt jumps into Kansas Governor's race |url=https://www.wibw.com/2025/07/09/schmidt-jumps-into-kansas-governors-race/ |access-date=July 9, 2025 |publisher=[[WIBW-TV]] |location=Topeka |date=July 9, 2025 |language=en}}</ref>
